items.question: Which areas does Ecoshine Solution service?
items.answer: We currently service New South Wales, Western Australia and Tasmania, with the Australian Capital Territory launching 1 July 2026. See our Service Areas page for the specific cities and suburbs we cover.

items.question: Are your cleaning products actually eco-friendly?
items.answer: Yes. We use plant-based, non-toxic, eco-certified products on every job, so they are safe for kids, pets and staff without compromising on results.

items.question: Do I need to sign a long-term contract?
items.answer: No. We operate with no lock-in contracts, so you can start, pause or cancel your cleaning schedule at any time.

items.question: Are your cleaners insured and background-checked?
items.answer: Every Ecoshine cleaner is fully insured, police-checked and uniformed, and we carry comprehensive public liability cover on every job.

items.question: What happens if I'm not happy with a clean?
items.answer: We back every job with a satisfaction guarantee. If something is not up to standard, we will come back and put it right at no extra cost.

items.question: How quickly can I get a quote?
items.answer: Most quote requests are answered within 2 hours during business hours. Same-day and after-hours cleans can also be arranged.

items.question: What types of properties and sectors do you clean?
items.answer: We service childcare and education, healthcare and aged care, hospitality, retail, corporate offices, industrial and manufacturing sites, strata and residential buildings, government and public spaces, and more. See our Services and Sectors pages for the full list.

items.question: Do you only do recurring contracts, or one-off cleans too?
items.answer: Both. Alongside ongoing commercial contracts, we handle one-off deep cleans, post-construction and builders cleans, and specialist project work.

items.question: What are your operating hours?
items.answer: We're available Monday to Friday 7:00am to 6:00pm and Saturday 8:00am to 4:00pm. We're closed Sundays, with after-hours arrangements available on request.

items.question: How do I book a clean?
items.answer: Request a free quote online and our team will confirm the details and get you booked in, usually within 2 hours during business hours.

items.question: Do you bring your own cleaning equipment?
items.answer: Yes. Our teams arrive fully equipped with eco-certified products, colour-coded microfibre systems and commercial-grade machines, so you never need to supply anything.
